# Welcome

Hi, I'm **Miho Kawanami**.
I am a public health researcher with a background in nursing and epidemiology. 
My research interests center on understanding how social and structural conditions shape mental health and contribute to persistent health disparities.

I am particularly interested in identifying modifiable mechanisms through which social disadvantage—including economic hardship, discrimination, trauma, and neighborhood conditions—affects mental health across the life course. Ultimately, I hope to translate epidemiologic evidence into effective and scalable interventions that can disrupt cycles of disadvantage and improve population mental health.

You can find more about me on the [About](about.html) page.
